subject: Request: temporary rate waiver due to roadmap delay (Cumulus Health)
messages:
From: Cassandra Park <cassandra.park@cumulushealth.ai>
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation timing and rate concern (Cumulus Health)

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note from our side after the technical sync today — the streaming redaction pipeline (needed for our PHI redaction during inference) is not going to be ready in time for our July 15 go-live. Your engineering team confirmed a six-week delay to the kernel updates that enable low-latency streaming for the model variant we're using.

That gap materially increases our expected LLM spend (we'll need to run longer-context batch jobs while waiting for streaming) and pushes some internal stakeholders to question the ROI of the integration. Given the timing, Procurement asked whether Redwood can offer either a short-term rate reduction or a one-time credit to cover the extra inference cost for the first two months.

I've attached our Q2 usage report and a short note from our security team. We want to keep momentum — is there a path for a temporary concession while your roadmap catches up?

Thanks,
Cassandra Park
Head of AI Platform, Cumulus Health
[cassandra.park@cumulushealth.ai]

Attachments: usage_Q2.csv
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Cc: Cassandra Park <cassandra.park@cumulushealth.ai>
Date: Sat, 20 Jun 2026 12:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation timing and rate concern (Cumulus Health)

Team — forwarding Cassandra's note and usage file. Short ask: can we approve a one-time waiver or temporary promo rate to keep Cumulus on the platform while product ships the streaming redaction update? Details we need to decide: amount (% discount vs flat credit), duration (1–3 months), and who signs off (Rishi/Revenue ops + Finance).

Why this matters: Cumulus is a strategic mid-market account with strong expansion potential in healthcare. If we lose momentum now they are likely to pause the project and delay additional seats.

My suggested starting point: one-time credit equal to estimated incremental spend for 2 months (~$35k–$45k per usage file) OR a 25% unit-rate discount for the first 60 days — whichever is simpler operationally. I attached the SOW we have on file (SOW_Cumulus_v2.pdf).

Can Rishi or Marissa confirm the right approval route and if Finance can absorb the delta? Laura — can Product confirm the delivery ETA and any viable workaround that reduces the spike?

— Jasmine
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 21 Jun 2026 09:00:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation timing and rate concern (Cumulus Health)

Thanks for flagging. A few quick asks before I sign off:
- Confirm expected 12-month ARR and near-term invoice cadence (does Cumulus bill monthly or quarterly?)
- Please quantify the incremental spend estimate Cassandra mentioned (if usage_Q2.csv is the baseline, what's the delta by month?)
- Are they asking for credits on past invoices or future ones?

Operationally I prefer a simple one-time credit tied to the next invoice and a short-term unit discount (clears billing machinery) rather than ad-hoc monthly adjustments. If the credit is <$50k I can approve; above that I need SVP sign-off. Marissa — can you run a quick cost impact and show P&L for a $40k vs $60k waiver?

I'll loop in sales leadership if numbers exceed my limit.

— Rishi
Head of Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
From: laura.bennett@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, Cassandra Park <cassandra.park@cumulushealth.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Jun 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation timing and rate concern (Cumulus Health)

Hi all — quick product update to add context: the missing piece is a low-latency streaming adapter for the 70B variant Cumulus selected. The engineering blocker is a third-party kernel patch that requires extra validation on our end. Current ETA for a validated release is ~6 weeks from now (mid-August).

Workarounds we can offer immediately:
- Enable a hybrid batch/streaming flow that reduces peak token cost by ~30% for interactive sessions (requires ~2 weeks of engineering configuration on Cumulus' side).
- Provide a model recommendation (smaller quantized variant) that matches latency targets but with a potential accuracy delta for certain prompts.

I support a customer-facing concession to keep the deployment on track. From Product's POV, a one-time operational credit keyed to the additional cost due to the lack of streaming (we model that as 1.5x token spend for two months) is a reasonable goodwill gesture while we deliver the fix.

ETA remains mid-August for the native streaming fix. Happy to review the hybrid config with their engineers if they want to expedite.

— Laura Bennett
Director, Product Management | Redwood Inference
From: marissa.cole@redwood.ai
To: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai, rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 08:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation timing and rate concern (Cumulus Health)

Finance ops ran the numbers. Two options that are simple to implement in billing:

Option A — One-time invoice credit: $40,000 applied to next invoice (clean, single-line item)
Option B — Promotional unit-rate: 20% off consumption charges for 60 days (requires rate override for two billing cycles)

P&L impact (delta to Redwood revenue for FY26): Option A = ~$40k; Option B (estimated) = ~$36k–$48k depending on actual consumption.

Recommendation: approve Option A (one-time $40k credit). Rishi — you can approve up to $50k. If we go above that, we need SVP approval and a short note in the contract amendment. I added a pricing_impact_sheet.xlsx to the thread with details and a link to the HubSpot deal in my notes.

If approved, Ops can create the credit and I can send a short amendment to the SOW for signature.

— Marissa Cole
Revenue Operations Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments: pricing_impact_sheet.xlsx
From: jasmine.liu@redwood.ai
To: Cassandra Park <cassandra.park@cumulushealth.ai>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai, laura.bennett@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 22 Jun 2026 16:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation timing and rate concern (Cumulus Health)

Hi Cassandra — following up with a proposed path forward from our side (internal approvals in thread). We propose the following concrete terms to keep your go-live on track: 

1) One-time invoice credit of $40,000 applied to your next invoice (Option A).
2) Product workaround: our Product team will deliver a hybrid batch/streaming configuration that should reduce your token cost ~30% while the streaming adapter is validated (engineering contact: laura.bennett@redwood.ai).
3) ETA: native streaming adapter targeted for mid-August; we'll provide weekly progress updates.

If this is acceptable, please confirm and I will route a short SOW amendment + DocuSign to formalize the credit and updated timeline. Once you confirm, Ops will generate the credit and apply it to your next invoice.

Thanks for working through this together — we want to make sure you can proceed with the implementation without losing momentum.

Best,
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
